results.statement: A stack bead under the phase epic must hold the entire stack (ordered layers with branch, PR, head, base, linked) as the only record of layer order; sanity-stack and the lead must claim it before any stack write and release it after; when GraphQL is back the subagent links every layer recorded unlinked; the bead closes when the stack lands.
results.quote: There needs to be local ledger the agent writes, which would be the phase bead if I understand properly.  entire stack would land in the phase bead.  |  One other responsibility of the subagent would be if graphql was out, but we can use not, it would stack ALL skipped layers.  |  On a side note, lead should probably coordinate w/ this agent as well when stacking work needs to be done.  this makes me think perhaps we need a stack-lock bead (child of phase epic).  stack-lock would be claimed before updating stack and returned to open when stack was complete.  (i believe using a bd as a lock is a known pattern.  stack-lock bead would represent a single stack, and woudl be closed when stack was merged.)
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18 (second round): Rand's sanity-stack, stack bead and lock rulings (atm-bd-orchestration PR #342, docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md)
results.deterministic_check: bd show <stack bead> --json after two links shows layers in link order; a link attempted without the claim is absent from the procedures; a lean-mode layer shows linked false and the next full-mode spawn links it first
